questions: Should each customer have one set of measurements that you update when they change, or should each order keep its own measurements?
When a customer collects an order, must the full price be paid first, or should you be able to record the rest of the payment at pickup?
Can two customers share the same phone number, or should each phone number belong to only one customer?
answers: One set of measurements on each customer, since customers have measurements and editing customers is not needed now.
